title: Candidate
description: The reviewable unit (PR-002). Created 1:1 when a Signal reaches status=NORMALIZED. Carries pattern suggestions and the review/promotion lifecycle that Signal itself does not. candidate_patterns is always a scored list, never a bare `pattern` field — the classifier suggests, humans decide. See docs/signal-lifecycle.md.

candidate_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this candidate.

signal_id.description: The Signal this candidate was created from. One candidate per signal.

review_state.description: Candidate-level lifecycle state. Starts at NORMALIZED (mirrors the parent Signal's status at the moment of candidate creation), then advances independently of Signal.status. See docs/signal-lifecycle.md for why NORMALIZED appears on both objects and why that's intentional, not duplication.

candidate_patterns.description: Scored list of candidate pattern matches. Never collapse to a single assigned value — this is what preserves editorial judgment at review.

name.description: Pattern name, matched against the Patterns database (15 definitions).

confidence.description: Denormalized top-line confidence (e.g. the highest-scoring candidate_patterns entry), kept for review-surface sorting/filtering. candidate_patterns remains the authoritative scored list; this is a convenience projection of it, not a separate judgment.

review_owner.description: Current reviewer identity (e.g. 'human:alice', 'atlas-v1'), denormalized for fast reads. The append-only reviews table is the authoritative history of every review event, not this field.

review_notes.description: Current/latest review note, denormalized. See the reviews table for the full note history.

updated_at.description: Last time this row's mutable fields (review_state, review_owner, review_notes, confidence) changed.
